features.statement: Page uses landmark and semantic elements (nav, main, figure, figcaption, blockquote, time) rather than generic div/section wrappers.
Page has a single h1 containing the hero headline words, with a clean heading hierarchy.
Images carry descriptive alt text, including the logo, rather than empty or irrelevant alt values.
Markup is minimal: one inline style block, no external stylesheets, few classes and little inline styling.
Page title is short and names only the organization, without SEO keyword repetition.
Typography uses a single Helvetica Neue family throughout.
Body text is large (about 17px) with generous line height around 1.65.
Headings are large: h2 around 43px and hero h1 around 80px at extra-bold weight.
Small uppercase eyebrow labels with wide letter-spacing sit above headings and in footer column headings.
Buttons and CTAs are fully rounded pills with uppercase label text.
Palette centers on deep navy and vivid magenta, with yellow highlights as accents.
Light sections use pale gray or white backgrounds, set explicitly, alternating with dark navy bands.
Hero is left-aligned with a stacked headline over a full-bleed photo, with the tagline directly on the image and no backing panel.
Content sits in a contained container about 1120px wide, aligned to a common left edge.
Sections use two-column layouts, such as text beside grouped pill links, and news and events lists side by side, built with CSS grid.
Statistics appear as white rounded cards with colored numerals and sentence-case gray captions.
Pull quote is a blockquote with an accent-colored left rule.
Section headings carry a short yellow underline bar accent.
List items show small accent-colored dates above titles, with hairline dividers between items.
Links end with a text arrow (→), including 'View All' links, in royal blue on light backgrounds.
Footer is a multi-column link directory with uppercase headings, a newsletter column and a bottom bar of plain text links.
Outlined pill chips act as topic or category links, including district names on dark sections.
Full-width colored promo strip with a white pill button advertises a campaign below the hero.
Full-bleed photo band with a linked photo credit separates content sections.
Corners shift from square to rounded, with pill-radius elements and no small-radius corners.
Typographic punctuation is used: en dashes, curly quotes and em dashes in copy.
Dark utility bar with text links for media, meetings and social sits above a navy nav band.
